title: Copy-Paste Layer-Crossing Mapping Blocks
pattern: Manually writing identical, straight-line field-to-field assignment mapping logic across multiple layer-boundary transfer models.
why_bad: Changing a structural type or field name requires finding and updating every copy-paste translation method, causing frequent compilation breaking gaps.
detection: Multiple functions performing isomorphic copying assignments between separate struct types.
counterexample: Transformation mappers that filter, rename, or fundamentally enrich structural formats differently.
fix: Abstract the transfer mapping into a single reusable mapping function or utilize dynamic/macro-based field mapping.
source: *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture*, "Double Mapping", p. 251.
